answers.how: A quadratic fit to spacecraft positions gives acceleration ≈171 px/s², so the scale is 42.75 px/m. Its length is ≈262 px; 262/42.75 ≈6.13 m.
Using the acceleration-derived scale of 42.75 px/m, the spacecraft's ≈121 px width is 121/42.75 ≈2.83 m.
The fitted motion starts from rest with constant acceleration. At 0.5 s, speed is 4 × 0.5 = 2 m/s.
The fitted motion starts from rest with constant acceleration. At 1.0 s, speed is 4 × 1.0 = 4 m/s.
